description: feotest's conformance scope beyond the oracle's family-mandatory tier. Extend-only: suites listed here are additional obligations; nothing here can subtract from the manifest's familyMandatory roster. These are the optional suites of features feotest implements: the regression cutoff without a verdict and the threshold-first inversion, design and resolved sizing of the regression rule, the nearest-rank percentile and its emission minimums with the latency existence and non-degeneracy gates, and explicit latency requirements. Owner-reviewed; a suite absent from both tiers is reported as unaddressed by every conformance run, never silently skipped.
